senses.gloss: (cmp. טרק a. נְטַר) to guard, lock up, bolt.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 19:6">Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 6</cite> Ar. a. Levita (ed. <he>אחד</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 14:3">Targ. Y. Ex. XIV, 3</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ט׳ תרעא</he> (<he>חד מירו׳</he>) <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> locked the door.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:18">Ib. to I, 18</cite> <he>טְרוֹדוּ תרעין</he> shut the doors closely.—Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ <he>תרעה טָרִיד</he> if her door is found locked, contrad. to <he>מוגף</he>, v. <cite ref="C00455"><he>גּוּף</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 49:1">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 1</cite>.
